verses.greek: Διὸ ἀφέντες τὸν τῆς ἀρχῆς τοῦ Χριστοῦ λόγον ἐπὶ τὴν τελειότητα φερώμεθα, μὴ πάλιν θεμέλιον καταβαλλόμενοι μετανοίας ἀπὸ νεκρῶν ἔργων, καὶ πίστεως ἐπὶ θεόν,
verses.literal: Therefore having left the the beginning the of Christ of the teaching to the maturity we may go on not again a foundation laying of repentance from dead works and faith in God
verses.dgt: Therefore, leaving the elementary teaching about Christ, let us be carried on to maturity, not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works and faith toward God,

verses.greek: βαπτισμῶν διδαχὴν ἐπιθέσεώς τε χειρῶν, ἀναστάσεώς τε νεκρῶν καὶ κρίματος αἰωνίου.
verses.literal: about baptisms about teaching about laying on then of hands about the resurrection both of the dead and about judgment eternal.
verses.dgt: instruction about washings, laying on of hands, resurrection of the dead, and eternal judgment.

verses.greek: καὶ τοῦτο ποιήσομεν ἐάνπερ ἐπιτρέπῃ ὁ θεός.
verses.literal: And this we will do if indeed shall permit the God.
verses.dgt: And this we will do, if God permits.

verses.greek: Ἀδύνατον γὰρ τοὺς ἅπαξ φωτισθέντας γευσαμένους τε τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς ἐπουρανίου καὶ μετόχους γενηθέντας πνεύματος ἁγίου
verses.literal: It is impossible for to those once having been enlightened having tasted then of the gift the heavenly and partakers having become of the Spirit Holy
verses.dgt: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, who tasted the heavenly gift, became sharers in the Holy Spirit,

verses.greek: καὶ καλὸν γευσαμένους θεοῦ ῥῆμα δυνάμεις τε μέλλοντος αἰῶνος,
verses.literal: and the goodness having tasted of God’s declaration the power also of the coming age —
verses.dgt: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the coming age,

verses.greek: καὶ παραπεσόντας, πάλιν ἀνακαινίζειν εἰς μετάνοιαν, ἀνασταυροῦντας ἑαυτοῖς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ παραδειγματίζοντας.
verses.literal: and then having fallen away — again to restore them to repentance crucifying in themselves the Son the of God and subjecting Him to open shame.
verses.dgt: and then fell away, to renew them again to repentance, since they crucify again for themselves the Son of God and expose him to public shame.

verses.greek: γῆ γὰρ ἡ πιοῦσα τὸν ἐπʼ αὐτῆς ἐρχόμενον πολλάκις ὑετόν, καὶ τίκτουσα βοτάνην εὔθετον ἐκείνοις διʼ οὓς καὶ γεωργεῖται, μεταλαμβάνει εὐλογίας ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ·
verses.literal: Land for the having drunk in the upon it coming often rain and producing vegetation useful for those for the sake of whom also it is tilled partakes of blessing from the God
verses.dgt: For land that drinks the rain often falling on it and produces vegetation useful to those for whose sake it is cultivated receives blessing from God,

verses.greek: ἐκφέρουσα δὲ ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀδόκιμος καὶ κατάρας ἐγγύς, ἧς τὸ τέλος εἰς καῦσιν.
verses.literal: That bringing forth however thorns and thistles is worthless and a curse near to of which the end is unto burning.
verses.dgt: but if it produces thorns and thistles, it is worthless and near a curse, and its end is burning.

verses.greek: Πεπείσμεθα δὲ περὶ ὑμῶν, ἀγαπητοί, τὰ κρείσσονα καὶ ἐχόμενα σωτηρίας, εἰ καὶ οὕτως λαλοῦμεν·
verses.literal: We have been persuaded however concerning you beloved of the things better and things accompanying salvation if even like this we speak.
verses.dgt: But concerning you, beloved, we are convinced of better things—things belonging to salvation—even though we speak this way.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ ἄδικος ὁ θεὸς ἐπιλαθέσθαι τοῦ ἔργου ὑμῶν καὶ τῆς ἀγάπης ἧς ἐνεδείξασθε εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, διακονήσαντες τοῖς ἁγίοις καὶ διακονοῦντες.
verses.literal: Not for unjust is the God to forget the work of you and the love that you have shown toward the name of Him having ministered to the saints and still ministering.
verses.dgt: For God is not unjust so as to forget your work and the love you showed for his name by serving the saints and continuing to serve them.

verses.greek: ἐπιθυμοῦμεν δὲ ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὴν αὐτὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι σπουδὴν πρὸς τὴν πληροφορίαν τῆς ἐλπίδος ἄχρι τέλους,
verses.literal: We desire now each of you the same to show earnestness toward the full assurance of the hope unto the end
verses.dgt: And we desire each of you to show the same diligence toward the full assurance of hope until the end,

verses.greek: ἵνα μὴ νωθροὶ γένησθε, μιμηταὶ δὲ τῶν διὰ πίστεως καὶ μακροθυμίας κληρονομούντων τὰς ἐπαγγελίας.
verses.literal: so that not sluggish you may be imitators however of those through faith and patience inheriting the promises.
verses.dgt: so that you may not become sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

verses.greek: Τῷ γὰρ Ἀβραὰμ ἐπαγγειλάμενος ὁ θεός, ἐπεὶ κατʼ οὐδενὸς εἶχεν μείζονος ὀμόσαι, ὤμοσεν καθʼ ἑαυτοῦ,
verses.literal: the For to Abraham having made His promise the God since by no one He had greater to swear He swore by Himself
verses.dgt: For when God made the promise to Abraham, since he had no one greater by whom to swear, he swore by himself,

verses.greek: λέγων· Εἰ μὴν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ σε·
verses.literal: saying If surely blessing I will bless you and multiplying I will multiply you
verses.dgt: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

verses.greek: καὶ οὕτως μακροθυμήσας ἐπέτυχεν τῆς ἐπαγγελίας.
verses.literal: And thus having waited patiently he obtained the promise.
verses.dgt: And so, having waited patiently, he obtained the promise.

verses.greek: ἄνθρωποι γὰρ κατὰ τοῦ μείζονος ὀμνύουσιν, καὶ πάσης αὐτοῖς ἀντιλογίας πέρας εἰς βεβαίωσιν ὁ ὅρκος·
verses.literal: Men for by one greater swear and in all their disputes finally comes to confirmation in the oath
verses.dgt: For people swear by someone greater, and for them an oath for confirmation is the end of every dispute.

verses.greek: ἐν ᾧ περισσότερον βουλόμενος ὁ θεὸς ἐπιδεῖξαι τοῖς κληρονόμοις τῆς ἐπαγγελίας τὸ ἀμετάθετον τῆς βουλῆς αὐτοῦ ἐμεσίτευσεν ὅρκῳ,
verses.literal: In which more excessive desiring the God to show to the heirs of the promise the unchangeableness of the purpose of Him guaranteed it by an oath
verses.dgt: In this way, when God desired to show more clearly to the heirs of the promise the unchangeable nature of his purpose, he guaranteed it with an oath,

verses.greek: ἵνα διὰ δύο πραγμάτων ἀμεταθέτων, ἐν οἷς ἀδύνατον ψεύσασθαι θεόν, ἰσχυρὰν παράκλησιν ἔχωμεν οἱ καταφυγόντες κρατῆσαι τῆς προκειμένης ἐλπίδος·
verses.literal: so that through two things unchangeable in which it is impossible to lie for God strong encouragement we may have the having fled for refuge to take hold of what is being set before us hope
verses.dgt: so that through two unchangeable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we who have fled for refuge might have strong encouragement to hold firmly to the hope set before us.

verses.greek: ἣν ὡς ἄγκυραν ἔχομεν τῆς ψυχῆς, ἀσφαλῆ τε καὶ βεβαίαν καὶ εἰσερχομένην εἰς τὸ ἐσώτερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος,
verses.literal: which as an anchor we have of the soul sure both and unshakable and entering into that within the veil
verses.dgt: We have this hope as an anchor of the soul, both secure and firm, entering into the inner place behind the curtain,

verses.greek: ὅπου πρόδρομος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν εἰσῆλθεν Ἰησοῦς, κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ ἀρχιερεὺς γενόμενος εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
verses.literal: where the forerunner for us has entered Jesus according to the order of Melchizedek a high priest having become to the age.
verses.dgt: where Jesus entered as a forerunner for us, having become a high priest forever according to the order of Melchizedek.
